name: COSMOS (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science) at UC Merced
what_you_do: Live at UC Merced for four weeks in summer and study advanced science and math topics with professors and researchers. The classes are hands-on and include a lot of lab work.
who_can_apply: California high school students completing grades 8 to 12. Only California high school students can apply. The page says a typical student has a GPA of 3.5 or higher. You apply to one COSMOS campus.
pay_detail: $5,518 for the four-week program (2026), which covers housing, meals, field trips and activities. $46 application fee. Card payments add a 2.5% fee. Optional financial aid application.
duration: 4 weeks, living on campus (July 5 to Aug 1 in 2026)
deadline_text: The UC Merced pages still show 2026 dates. Last cycle, the application opened Jan 7, 2026 at 8 a.m. and closed Feb 6, 2026. Financial aid forms had to be postmarked by Feb 7, 2026. Decisions came Mar 26, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply online by the deadline. You need teacher letters, a parent signature and the fee. If you get in, pay one third first. Pay the rest about a week later.
notes: UC Merced first hosted COSMOS in summer 2026. Each campus takes about 160 to 200 students, so it is competitive. The financial aid deadline has no extensions. All money matters must go through a parent or guardian. COSMOS also runs at UC Davis, UC Irvine, UCLA, UC San Diego and UC Santa Cruz.
